authority_note: Interfaces define exchange capability only; authority per charter authority-matrix. No adapter holds approval or unrestricted publication authority.
exchange_model: signed immutable packages + CloudEvents envelopes + receipts; transactional outbox/inbox; at-least-once with idempotent consumers; no shared business tables, no dual writes, no distributed transactions, no counterparty credentials

inbound.payload_contract: typed findings against exact asset/copy/placement/source versions

source-drift: mark affected associations stale; propose revalidation/replacement/withdrawal/waiver to proper authority; never silently delete published work

outbound.rule: receiving system imports as unapproved; Storyworld creative approval is evidence, not authorization
